newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran stock index down 1.3 percent in January.
newsitem.headline: Iran stock index down 1.3 percent in January.

text.p: Shares on Tehran's stock exchange dropped 1.3 percent in January, a newspaper said on Saturday.
The daily Jomhuri Eslami said the all-share index ended the month at 1942.70, down from 1967.32 at the end of December.
The index, which covers shares of the 224 companies listed on the market, fell 3.9 percent in December.
Market officials have attributed the fall to recent issues of some 3.3 billion shares and the appearance of additional investment companies offering shares.
Despite the slide in late 1996, the index registered a gain of 52.7 percent in the course of the year.
Market capitalisation stood at the end of 1996 at 29.56 trillion rials ($9.9 billion at the official exchange rate), up from 16.01 trillion at the end of 1995.

Although permitted, foreign investment in the exchange is put at only two to four percent of shares, primarily because of tough foreign exchange rules which stop investors from repatriating their earnings from share sales in hard cash.
Foreign investors are allowed to hold up to 49 percent equity in Iranian firms.
($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
